## Google Maps Lead Finder

Accepts a business category and location, runs the CoreClaw Google Maps Lead Finder Worker, and returns structured local business leads ready for a CRM, spreadsheet, or outreach workflow.

### Setup

Set CORECLAW_API_KEY in n8n, activate the webhook, and send a POST request with keyword and location.

### Output

Each result includes business contact and location data when available.

## Receive lead criteria

The webhook accepts a keyword, target location, and optional result limit.

## Find local leads

CoreClaw retrieves relevant Google Maps business leads in a single synchronous request.

## Return lead data

The response is normalized into business records for downstream sales automation.
